annotations.title: Withdrawal status and network fees: which exchanges paused withdrawals, per asset and network

description: Call this when the user asks whether an exchange has paused withdrawals or deposits, which networks are open for an asset, what the withdrawal fee or minimum is on each venue, or which venue is cheapest to withdraw from. Without arguments returns the overview (withdrawals paused right now, ranked, plus recent suspension and resumption events). Pass asset (e.g. USDT) for every venue and network of that asset, and venue (e.g. kucoin) to narrow. Recorded daily by ByKaranteli from 20+ venues' public currency lists. The overview lists the first 30 paused networks and the 30 newest events; pass asset, or limit (up to 400) for more.

asset.description: string, optional asset code, e.g. USDT

limit.description: Optional. Rows of the overview lists (paused networks, events) without asset (default 30).

venue.description: string, optional venue id, e.g. kucoin

name: get_withdrawal_status
